conclusion: Orca upstream/main through fd28f6c189 expands legacy embedded material per-variant arrays before config diffing and selects/deletes all current-plate instances that are contained or intersecting. The local merge preserves Inlong branding/profiles, exact-output optimization sources and disabled application-update policy. The changed core and preset tests build, the new legacy-material regression runs, and the changed Selection.cpp compiles. Installed binaries and all832 current settings files remain byte-identical. GUI interaction and a new full slicing benchmark were not performed.
